name: reading-comprehension
description: Twenty grounded reading-comprehension questions across four short reports. Answers are contained in or directly calculated from each report.

tasks.prompt: Read the report: Harbor Library opened its new reading room on 12 March. The room has 36 seats. On what date did the reading room open? Answer with the date.
